threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'corner shop' instead of a 'bodega' and get confused when people refer to the 'fridge' as a 'chiller.'
Caught a glimpse of a guy serenading a traffic cone on the 133 last night. Only in Brixton, right? The late hours bring out the true characters.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a guy juggling flaming torches at Platz der Luftbrücke while waiting for a bus. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you see a kebab shop and a gallery cohabitating in a repurposed water tower, embodying Berlin’s love for creative contrasts.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local will notice that the taco trucks have their own line of BART delays during late-night runs. It's a delicate dance out there.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 Mission at rush hour. A guy was juggling while a woman next to him quietly read Kafka. Just another day in the city.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they're experiencing Gràcia at its best by sticking to Plaça del Sol, but the real charm hides in the narrow alleys where the locals gather.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the bewildered expressions at the entrance of supermercats when they struggle with the self-checkout machine. It’s a rite of passage here.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep looking up at the street signs for inspiration, forgetting every shop's got a different name than it had last week.
Caught a bloke singing old David Bowie on the 3 last night. Had the whole back of the bus clapping, proper Brixton vibe! Made the dreary ride feel like a gig.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a kebab shop serving midnight breakfast burritos. Only in Neukölln do cravings meet creativity like that.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you stumble upon a döner with a side of art installation in a public park—just another casual day in the Spree-side culture.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they're from here when they can spot a tourist in Dolores Park just by their overly careful picnic setup.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy on a Muni bus argue with the driver about whether the next stop was Potrero or Mission. You'd think he was debating world peace.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Plaza del Sol is always lively, but it empties out by 11 PM. Locals prefer the secret corners after dark.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell a recent arrival by the way they stand waiting for the light to change at pedestrian crossings—even at 3am.
